# Pattern Brands

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 4 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Retail brand index: white page, forest-green pill and footer, P22 Mackinac Pro at weight 400, Cadiz footer links, three brand cards.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out, public marketing only. Themes: light.

Public marketing capture of [patternbrands.com](https://patternbrands.com/), measured signed out on 2026-11-19. The start URL redirected to `https://www.patternbrands.com/`. Pages read: home, terms of service, privacy policy (the footer href redirects), and a 404. The live viewport was 1169 by 731 CSS pixels, device pixel ratio 2. No account, no email sent, no purchase, no card.

The site is a one-page brand index plus two legal pages. Page ground is white. Type is #1e1e1e in P22 Mackinac Pro. The action and the footer are #084935. Footer type is Cadiz. A lighter green circle (#1d9671) is the button hover fill, collapsed at rest.

Screenshot frames failed in the preview browser (`The browser is not producing screenshot frames`). Values below come from `getComputedStyle` on the live page and from `:root` custom properties in the Webflow stylesheets that page loaded.

## Typography

7 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Cadiz, P22 Mackinac Pro.

### Fonts (from README.md)

P22 Mackinac Pro Book is the page face, loaded as woff2 from the Webflow CDN, with Georgia then sans-serif as the fallback the computed style reported. Cadiz Regular is the footer face, with Arial then sans-serif. Both files are licensed type and are not in this package. The tokens name the families the page computed, then those fallbacks.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

There are no screenshots. The preview browser returned `The browser is not producing screenshot frames`. Do not treat a missing image as a layout you have seen.

Dark theme was not on the public pages. `color-scheme` was `normal`. There is no dark token set.

Blue (#2d62ff) is `--link-color--link-primary` and `--base-color-system--focus-state`. The links that were open were green (product cards) or ink with an underline (legal copy). Do not paint links blue from this capture.

Pink, success, warning, and error colours are on `:root` and were not painted. The Webflow input focus border rgb(56, 152, 236) is a library default. No field was on these pages.

The button hover circle was 0 by 0 at rest. Its colour is measured. Its expanded size is the hover rule, not a held state.

`icon.png` is the 32px favicon scaled to 128. It is soft.

The stylesheet filename contains `pattern-staging`. The live host was `www.patternbrands.com`.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Green pill, white page.** The action fill is #084935 and the page is #ffffff. See [components.md](components.md).
- **Mackinac for the page, Cadiz for the footer.** Headings and buttons use P22 Mackinac Pro at weight 400. Footer links use Cadiz at 14px.
- **One radius on the home button.** The fill is 24px on a 44px control. The 404 pill uses 1600px. Do not mix them on one control.
- **Do not invent a dark theme.** `color-scheme` was normal and no switch was on the page.
- **Do not send the contact mail or open a checkout.** Contact Us is mailto. The brand stores are other sites. No card was entered.
